title: Fix 262 open race
no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-history-006 already says a session that cannot be read stops no other command; this closes a window in the reader added for #262. Only the readers and their tests change.
acceptance_criteria: The bounded record reader opens a path without blocking and checks on the opened handle that it is a regular file, so a FIFO at the path at the moment of the open is refused at once; chough session shelve reads session.md and each listed file through the same non-blocking open.

answers.constraints: The specs/cli/cli.3md lesson on native tasks applies: human gates are listed as plain text in tasks.md, not as checkboxes. No other lesson or principle constrains it.
